articles.title: Gold's Resilience Tested by Fluctuating Yields and Persistent Fed Rate Hike Speculation
articles.troy_commentary:
The headlines miss the point for anyone holding physical metal. Gold moved **$16** an oz today and the ratio sits near **69.6:1**, which still leaves silver cheap against gold by its long-run average.

What matters for your stack is the trend in real rates and what central banks keep doing with their reserves. Watch the next CPI print and the Treasury auctions this week.
